title: 把 Vault OSS 当成 LDAP + TOTP 登录网关：两阶段编排与首次绑定
description: On a single Killercoda host: start OpenLDAP with user alice, dev-mode Vault, the OSS TOTP secrets engine, and a tiny Go website on :8080. The website orchestrates two-stage login itself: LDAP auth returns a pending Vault token, then totp/code/alice validates the OTP before the token is promoted to a logged-in session. Step 1 inspects the preconfigured auth/ldap, totp engine, identity alias, and narrow policy. Step 2 shows the not-yet-enrolled state and runs enrollment to create totp/keys/alice. Step 3 drives the full flow from curl and browser. Step 4 explores wrong OTP, replayed TOTP code, token cleanup, and audit logs.

steps.title: 第一步：检查 OSS 两阶段登录的基础配置
